versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed

## Reader & Novels

* **Smart Double-Page Mode** (#1008):
  * Automatically switch to double-page view based on screen orientation (landscape/portrait).
  * Chapter transition pages now remain isolated for a natural, seamless reading experience.
* **Complete Novel Reader Overhaul** (#1014):
  * Added double-page reading mode support for novels.
  * Added a **Keep screen on** toggle to prevent the display from turning off while reading (#1014).
  * Added smooth auto-scroll with fine-tuned speed controls.
  * Redesigned Novel bottom bar and settings sheets: more compact, with quick font-size adjustments.
  * Centralized all novel settings under **More > Settings > Novel Reader** (#1014).
* **Smooth Webtoon Scrolling**:
  * Much smoother continuous scrolling without stutter or layout jumps.
  * Fluid auto-scroll that reacts instantly to touch and drag gestures.
* **Reliable Page Error Recovery**:
  * The **Retry** button is now immediately clickable with no menu overlay interference.
  * Added a manual **Refresh** button in the reader top bar to re-fetch fresh pages from the source.
* **Dedicated Page Cache**:
  * Redesigned chapter caching system (100 MB disk limit with automatic cleanup of older files) to save storage and speed up loading times.

---

##  Features & User Experience

* **Quick Resume from History** (#1005):
  * Double-tap or double-click the **History** icon in the navigation bar to instantly jump straight back into your latest read chapter or watched episode (filtered by Manga, Anime, or Novel).
* **One-Tap Global Search**:
  * Tap any title in the entry details header to immediately search for it across all extensions (long-press continues to copy to clipboard).
  * Warns you before adding an entry that is already in your library.
* **Customizable Chapter Swipe Actions** (#1005):
  * Configure left and right swipe gestures for chapters in Reader settings (Mark as Read/Unread, Bookmark, Download, or Disable).
* **Mass Migration from Library** (#1005):
  * Added a dedicated shortcut button in the multi-select bottom action bar to quickly migrate multiple selected entries at once.
* **Automatic Sync** (#1012):
  * Added background auto-sync support and improved sync preference handling.

---

## Video Player & Desktop

* **Desktop Controls & Performance** (#1015):
  * Eliminated stutter caused by mouse hover on the player controls.
  * Added a setting to toggle hardware acceleration on Windows.
* **Audio & Subtitle Tracks**:
  * Better track synchronization, duplicate removal, and cleaner track labels.

---

##  Localization

* Fully updated and completed translations across **17 languages** (French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, and more).

---

##  Fixes & Stability

* Fixed visual layout overflow issues in settings sheets and bottom bars (#1014).
* Improved error handling and reliability for Kitsu discovery (#1011).
* File picker improvements and stability updates (#1010).

---
